what_i_did: Read lab/TASKS.md, tasks/constraints/spec.md, tasks/constraints/dev.json and the text checkers in lab/core.py (run_check).
Wrote 21 single-mode tasks g4-01..g4-21 with a Python builder script (kept in the session scratchpad, not in the repo).

Rules covered: all-uppercase, all-lowercase, required first word, required last word, no digits, forbidden word, required words, capitalize each word, prefix + uppercase lines, forbidden words with required opening, first and last word, lowercase without punctuation, no commas, forbidden-word rewrite, lipogram without the letter e, alternating case by line, same initial letter, positively phrased rules, title-case headline with forbidden words, capitals only on first and last word, no digits + no commas + one capitalised word.
verification: No arithmetic answers in this sub-theme; correctness is constraint satisfaction, so each reference and negative was executed against the real lab.core.run_check.

In addition to reference/negative, 21 alternative correct replies (expected pass) and 54 alternative near-miss replies (expected fail) were run through the same checkers; all behaved as expected (0 problems).
Every prohibition is paired with a positive content check and a minimum length (min_words or a regex repetition count); case rules use flags "".
not_done: No model pilot was run on these tasks (held-out), so the easy/medium/hard labels are estimates from the spec's baseline guidance, not measured.
Did not read other generators' files, so cross-generator overlap was not checked.
known_limits: Free-writing tasks check topic only through required tokens (names, required words); an off-topic sentence containing those tokens would pass.
g4-10 requires the word 'flour' and g4-15 forbids the letter e case-insensitively; both are stated explicitly in the prompts.
